usageNote: 这是个动词短语，hope to do sth表达期望！说梦想职业时超好用，语气带点憧憬感～

examples.en: Many graduates hope to get jobs in the hotel industry after finishing school.
examples.zh: 很多毕业生希望毕业后能在酒店行业找到工作。

examples.en: She studied hospitality management because she hopes to get a job in the hotel.
examples.zh: 她学了酒店管理专业，因为她希望能在酒店工作。
